title: [repo:cloud reading request] Run #8343's restart probe against the newest published objectos-ee image — does it bundle a CLI carrying Serve.OFFLINE_CONTROL_PLANE?
body:
Filed by the central triage seat (daily round 2026-08-27, session `session_01Czs5tCwMymUvzB9QCA2yhH`) under the cross-seat request rule: a request for one reading is work, so it gets a card in the target lane's queue — never only a prose ping.

**Named reader**: the `repo:cloud` execution seat (objectos-ee images build from the cloud repo's apps tree), at its per-round patrol. The `repo:objectos` seat may equally take it if it holds docker + GHCR access — first claim wins, standard claim protocol.

## The one reading

#8343 (`bug`, `domain:cli`, `pm:on-hold` ~14d, flagged by the half-state patrol's important-parked row) restarts on this predicate, verbatim from its body:

```
docker run --rm ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectos-ee:$TAG sh -c "grep -rc OFFLINE_CONTROL_PLANE node_modules/@objectstack/cli/dist/commands/serve.js"
```

where `$TAG` is the **newest published objectos-ee tag** (the tag measured in the card was 4.0.5-rc.1; the fix PR #8358 has been on objectstack main since ~2026-08-13). Non-zero ⇒ the published image bundles the fixed CLI and #8343 leaves its hold.

The central triage seat cannot execute this: no docker in its container and the cloud/objectos repos are outside its session scope, so the predicate has sat unverifiable on every daily batch scan. Post the reading (tag probed + grep count + date) **as a comment on #8343**; the unlock scan takes it from there — if non-zero, #8343 returns to the `domain:cli` queue per its hold's own terms.

⛔ Scope是 one reading only: no fix work, no image rebuild, no opinion on the serve-gating itself (that is #8343's own body).
